jobs.title: Junior Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
About the role

Brightline Studio builds design-led products for climate startups. We are hiring a junior frontend developer to join our distributed team of nine.

What you'll do

  • Build accessible interfaces in React and TypeScript
  • Turn Figma designs into responsive components with Tailwind CSS
  • Review pull requests and pair with senior engineers

Requirements

  • Working knowledge of JavaScript and React
  • Comfortable with Git and code review
  • 0-2 years of professional or project experience
  • Clear written communication in English

Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js
  • Exposure to automated testing

We hire worldwide. Candidates must have the right to work where they live; we do not sponsor visas.
